description: Na₂CrCAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.85 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.06 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.33 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-55°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one As atom.
